facts.summary: Modest early response rates from dose escalation data disappointed investors · Phase 1 · exarafenib in BRAF/NRAS-altered solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: BRAF-altered solid tumors and NRAS mutant melanoma

evidence.summary: In total, 6 patients achieved a partial response (PR) with exarafenib monotherapy treatment during dose escalation, including five confirmed PRs as evaluated by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST).
evidence.safety: Exarafenib was well-tolerated at substantial monotherapy exposures; only 3% (n=2/60) of patients discontinued therapy due to treatment-related adverse events
